## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Security / RLS
- [ ] Refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] `node --check` passes for every file in `js/`
- [ ] No `.env`, service-role key or other secret is included
- [ ] RLS policies and column grants were reviewed (if the database changed)
- [ ] Demo mode still works from `index.html`
- [ ] Admin flow was tested (if the admin panel changed)
- [ ] README / Greek operations docs updated when needed

## Screenshots

Add before/after screenshots for UI changes, if useful.
